title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22
source: Master Sounbdoard Reel > PCM > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Top‑shelf soundboard capture with a smoking Playing in the Band and buttery China Cat Sunflower.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this recording, calling it "top shelf" and praising its smooth, crystal‑clear sound. The performance is highlighted as a PITBAND (Playing in the Band) top‑10 moment with a silky rendition of China Cat Sunflower, making it one of the standout shows in their collections.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the audio fidelity; with no negatives mentioned, the show rates near‑perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recording as smooth, clear and "top shelf" with no reported dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a cohesive, high‑energy set with the PITBAND sequence ranking among their favorites.
